name: Honkai: Star Rail — Tracker Systems
description: High-priority output contracts for the HSR Scene Tracker and collapsible five-tab Status Tracker. Import alongside the main HSR lorebook. These entries supersede the older hsr_status.v1 contract.

0.comment: HSR • Scene Tracker Output Contract v1
0.content:
SCENE TRACKER — mandatory at the absolute top of every assistant roleplay response.

Output exactly one valid JSON object wrapped in <hsr_scene>...</hsr_scene> BEFORE narration, dialogue, headers, or any other tag. Never wrap it in Markdown fences. Keep this exact key order:

<hsr_scene>
{"schema":"hsr_scene.v1","time":"HH:MM","period":"dawn|day|dusk|night","weather":"text","temperature_c":number,"location":"text","zone":"text","situation":"brief current scene summary"}
</hsr_scene>

Rules:
- Update time, weather, temperature, location, zone, and situation only when the scene changes.
- Preserve the previous values when nothing changed.
- Keep situation concise but complete; punctuation and Thai text are allowed.
- The regex renders this as the always-visible Desolation Chronicle scene bar.
- Never output a second scene tracker in the same response.
0.name: HSR • Scene Tracker Output Contract v1

1.comment: HSR • Status Tracker Output Contract v2 — Collapsible Tabs
1.content:
STATUS TRACKER v2 — mandatory at the absolute bottom of every assistant roleplay response. THIS OVERRIDES any older hsr_status.v1 instruction.

Output exactly one valid JSON object wrapped in <hsr_status>...</hsr_status> AFTER all narration, dialogue, and other UI tags. Never write prose after it and never wrap it in Markdown fences. Use this structure:

<hsr_status>
{
  "schema":"hsr_status.v2",
  "lang":"en|th",
  "character":"name",
  "level":number,
  "vitality":{
    "hp":{"current":number,"max":number},
    "energy":{"current":number,"max":number},
    "bond":{"current":number,"max":number},
    "conditions":["text"]
  },
  "paths":{
    "current":"destruction|hunt|erudition|harmony|nihility|preservation|abundance|remembrance|elation|propagation|trailblaze",
    "element":"physical|fire|ice|lightning|wind|quantum|imaginary",
    "traces":[{"name":"text","level":number,"desc":"text"}]
  },
  "equipments":{
    "light_cone":{"name":"text","level":number,"superimposition":number,"desc":"text"},
    "relics":[{"name":"text","slot":"text","set":"text","level":number,"desc":"text"}],
    "consumables":[{"name":"text","qty":number,"desc":"text"}]
  },
  "quests":[{"name":"text","status":"ongoing|success|failed|paused","objective":"text","progress":0-100,"info":"text"}],
  "party":[{"name":"text","role":"text","element":"physical|fire|ice|lightning|wind|quantum|imaginary","path":"destruction|hunt|erudition|harmony|nihility|preservation|abundance|remembrance|elation|propagation|trailblaze","hp":{"current":number,"max":number}}]
}
</hsr_status>

Rules:
- Keep all five sections live: Vitality, Paths, Equipments, Quests, Party. Empty sections use [] or null where appropriate; do not omit the top-level section.
- Preserve prior values unless events change them. Do not reset HP, energy, bond, equipment, quest progress, or party composition without narrative cause.
- Match "lang" to the roleplay language.
- The regex renders a native HTML <details> panel with no open attribute, so Status starts collapsed. Tapping the summary expands it; the five tabs switch pages inside the open panel.
- Long names and descriptions are allowed. The UI wraps text and does not intentionally truncate fields.
- Never output more than one status block per response.
1.name: HSR • Status Tracker Output Contract v2 — Collapsible Tabs
